verdict.rationale: Time logging is a fair question for a task-management product like Trello, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows native time logging against cards or boards. The calendar sync item covers allocating focused time slots, which is planning rather than logging time spent. Power-Up and API docs are only developer building blocks, and no time-tracking Power-Up is named.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
